svg.title: Native bake and managed Image publication workflow
svg.desc: Each request uses a unique artifact directory with a fixed bake.exr output. The execution runtime matches receipts by session and job ID. The manager verifies the result signature and retains a ready artifact while publication is deferred. Dependency generations guard freshness. Publication, activation, and rollback share one admitted commit scope. Shared readers are synchronized after activation or restoration.
